newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Norilsk says combine paying most H1 taxes.
newsitem.headline: Russia Norilsk says combine paying most H1 taxes.

text.p: Russian mining group RAO Norilsk Nickel's flagship combine will pay 70 percent of first half taxes by the end of June, Interfax news agency quoted a senior official of the group as saying on Tuesday.

The combine will pay 138 billion roubles ($24 million) to the federal government and almost all taxes for the first half of the year to the Krasnoyarsk region and the city of Norilsk, where the company is located, Interfax quoted deputy chief executive in charge of finance Pavel Kadushin as saying.

Norilsk Nickel is one of Russia's biggest tax debtors with March tax arrears to all levels of government 1.2 trillion roubles. Kadushin attributed improved tax payments to better financial management in the company, Interfax said.
But he forecast Norilsk combine tax arrears would amount to over 1.4 trillion roubles without fines by July 1.
